headline: It's official: Social Security confirms minimum widow's pensions may be reduced in 2026 despite the general increase if recipients have extra income
summary: Spain's Social Security has confirmed that minimum widow's pensions may be reduced in 2026 despite the general increase if recipients have extra income. The pensions are a major item of public spending.
why: Pensions are a major component of Spain's state spending and the General State Budget. Changes to benefit rules affect household income and public finances.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Es oficial: la Seguridad Social confirma que pueden bajar las pensiones mínimas de viudedad en 2026 pese a la subida general si se tienen ingresos extra
